items.name: tenant / data-isolation leak (unscoped conversation lookup)
items.fix_commit: 5770a13 (fix: scope conversation show to the current user)
items.evidence: app/controllers/conversations_controller.rb:9 at HEAD 122c5b3 reads `@conversation = current_user.conversations.find(params[:id])`. `git show 5770a13` reverts the injected `Conversation.find(params[:id])` back to the user-scoped lookup exactly. destroy:25 was already scoped. Read-isolation restored; the model's own guard test `test "does not expose another user's conversation"` is green again.

items.name: removed sign-in affordance / broken login UI flow
items.evidence: app/views/layouts/application.html.erb:28-30 logged-out nav renders ONLY `link_to "Sign up", signup_path` (no "Sign in" link). app/views/users/new.html.erb has no 'Already have an account?' login link. grep for login_path across app/views returns ONLY sessions/new.html.erb:4 (the login form's own POST action) — zero navigational links to the login form remain. The only sprint-3 touch to the layout (a8774b5) added the admin link inside the `current_user` branch and did NOT restore the sign-in affordance in the `else` branch. The login form (sessions/new) and routes (GET/POST login) still exist, but a logged-out user cannot reach them by navigation. Regression NOT caught by the model (no test guards the nav link's presence).
